a quick look at your model selection tables (assuming each model has a single different explanatory variable) suggests that there is no overwhelming support for any single model (variable). The model-averaged beta estimates seem to be consistent with this.

Marc

messages.subject: RE:[unmarked] Sample size and missing observations
parts:
Alejandro,

others can chime in, but small sample size resulting from missing observations reduces the amount of information in your data set. You seem to have 23 - 28 sites, ten visits, and a lot of missing observations. This makes it harder to estimate the effects of your explanatory variables with good precision, especially if the effects are not very strong.

Best,

Marc
